name: SMG1 nonsense mediated mRNA decay associated PI3K related kinase

function.text: SMG1 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase SMG1. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and protein serine kinase activity. It participates in regulation of telomere maintenance and peptidyl-serine phosphorylation.

function.text: SMG1 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase SMG1. It is a serine/threonine protein kinase involved in both mRNA surveillance and genotoxic stress response pathways. It plays a central role in nonsense-mediated decay (NMD) of mRNAs containing premature stop codons by phosphorylating UPF1/RENT1. It also acts as a genotoxic stress-activated protein kinase that displays some functional overlap with ATM.
